title: Implement failure protocol (benchmark regressions create issues)
objective: Configure the e2e-benchmarks CI job so that benchmark test failures create GitHub issues instead of blocking merges, while compiler-pass failures still block.
scope: Set continue-on-error: true on e2e benchmark test step
Add step to create GitHub issue on failure via actions/github-script@v7
implementation_steps: Add continue-on-error: true to e2e test step
Add GitHub issue creation step triggered on failure
deliverables: Failure protocol in ci.yml e2e-benchmarks job
acceptance_criteria: Benchmark failures create issues instead of blocking merge
Compiler-pass test failures still block merge

cases: test_benchmark_step_has_continue_on_error: e2e benchmark test step in e2e-benchmarks job has continue-on-error: true
test_github_script_issue_creation_step_present: e2e-benchmarks job has a step with uses: actions/github-script@v7, if: failure(), and the benchmark-regression label

risks: continue-on-error only suppresses step failure -- the whole job still needs a separate issue-creating step, which is non-trivial and easy to misconfigure
actions/github-script@v7 requires the default GITHUB_TOKEN to have `issues: write` permission; missing permission block silently no-ops issue creation
completion_notes: Made the nightly e2e benchmark step non-blocking and added a GitHub issue creation path that self-creates the benchmark-regression label if it does not exist.
